profile.headline: Principal IT Software Engineer at Boston Scientific - Contact Center Specialist
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Voice Network Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the medical device and travel industries. Skilled in Telephony management for contact centers utilizing NICE CXone Cloud Contact Center, Avaya Products, Active Directory, and Windows Server. Strong information technology professional with an AAS focused in Networking and Data Communications from Hennepin Technical College.

positions.title: Principal IT Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: NICE Call Recording · Contact Centers · NICE CXone · Contact Center Optimization · Contact Center Transformation · Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) · Microsoft Power BI · Project Management · Contact Center Design · Troubleshooting · Contact Center Technology

positions.title: Senior Network Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for NICE inContact CXone Cloud Contact Center.  Responsibilities include establishing the scope of the requirements for each individual Contact Center, design of solution to be implemented, construction and scripting in CXone, Functional Testing, support of user acceptance testing, change control, go live and runtime support.
